Home.lead: We meet, exchange experiences and build partnerships — in business and beyond.

meetups.title: Business Brings Us Together. People Make It Meaningful.
meetups.text: Restaurant dinners, sauna outings, sports and trips outside the city — we choose settings where it's easy to connect and enjoy time together.

About.eyebrow: Who We Are and What We Do
About.title: About the Club
About.lead: A business networking club is a community of entrepreneurs where members meet people from across the business world, talk about their ventures, share experiences and practical advice, help one another identify challenges and growth opportunities, and discover new ways to collaborate.

activities.title: What We Do
activities.description: We get together in relaxed, informal settings — no lectures, mandatory agendas or unnecessary formalities.

items.title: Restaurant Dinners
items.text: We gather around the table and get to know one another in a relaxed atmosphere.

items.title: Sauna and Relaxation
items.text: We connect outside the usual business environment.

items.title: Sports and Activities
items.text: We stay active and find more ways to connect.

items.title: Trips Outside the City
items.text: We change the scenery, unwind and continue getting to know one another.

About.note: We don't offer business training or organize meetings with mentors. This isn't a business education club — it's a business networking club.

cta.title: Does This Sound Like Your Kind of Community?
cta.text: Learn more about becoming a member.

Join.title: How to Join
Join.lead: Membership is open to entrepreneurs who are actively running a business. New members are welcomed after a personal introduction. This helps us maintain a strong community and make sure you'll enjoy connecting with fellow members.

steps.title: Meet Us in Person
steps.text: Contact the organizer and arrange an introductory meeting.

steps.title: Tell Us About Yourself
steps.text: We'll get acquainted and learn about your business and interests.

steps.title: Become a Member
steps.text: After the introduction, you'll be able to join the club and our Facebook group.

rules.title: Club Guidelines
items: Each member covers their own expenses at events.
Selling products and persistent advertising within the club are not allowed.
We treat one another with respect and do not tolerate rude or disrespectful behavior.

cta.title: Great Connections Start with a Simple Introduction.

Footer.description: A business networking club. A nonprofit community of entrepreneurs brought together through conversation and mutual support.
